response.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT SUM(traitcount) AS total_features, COUNT(DISTINCT zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), site_sums AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref) SELECT ss.zoneref, ss.feature_count, CAST(ss.feature_count AS REAL) / t.total_features AS share, CAST(ss.feature_count AS REAL) / t.total_features - 1.0 / t.site_count AS margin FROM site_sums ss CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE CAST(ss.feature_count AS REAL) / t.total_features > 1.0 / t.site_count ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 10
